verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments gateway and API (card payments, refunds, 3DS, POS, payouts), not an AI agent or host app that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply. Its llms.txt and markdown docs only make its documentation readable by AI tools; they do not let it plug in MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
